title: Shape with both filter and blendMode drops the blend in SWF — frames.ts filter-only branch ordering
description:
CONFIRMED byte-level (QA follow-up to critical task 1238 PlaceObject3 HasFilterList fix).

REACHABLE: ShapeDisplayObject (packages/core/src/engine/types.ts:362) carries both `blendMode` (line 384) and `filters` (line 392) as independent optional fields; the model lets a raw shape have both set simultaneously.

DEFECT: packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts initial-placement branch (the shape/drawing-object emit, lines ~502-603). The else-if chain checks `hasEnabledFilters(displayObj.filters)` FIRST (line 512) and calls `encodePlaceObject3WithFilters(...)` (line 523), which carries NO blend mode. The shape blendMode branch (line 537, `encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode`) is only reachable when there are NO filters (it is `else if`). So a shape with BOTH filter and a non-normal blendMode emits a PlaceObject3 with the filter list but the blend silently dropped.

DIVERGES FROM INSTANCE PATH: the instance branch in the same file (lines ~875-936) does it correctly — it computes `hasBlend` and, when blend is present, uses `encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(charId, depth, x, y, blendMode, displayObj.filters, ...)` which carries BOTH the blend AND the filter list; only when no blend does it fall to filters-only. The shape path should mirror this.

SWF-DUMP EVIDENCE (tools/swf-dump, Ruffle swf crate). Built a doc with a SHAPE (red rect) carrying a yellow Glow filter AND blendMode='multiply', and an equivalent INSTANCE with both, compiled via compileDocument, dumped the PlaceObject3:
  SHAPE PlaceObject3:    filters: [GlowFilter(...)]   (no blendMode field)   <-- blend DROPPED
  INSTANCE PlaceObject3: blendMode: "Multiply", filters: [GlowFilter(...)]   <-- both present (correct)

EXPECTED: shape PlaceObject3 carries BOTH the filter list AND blendMode=Multiply, identical to the instance path.
ACTUAL: shape PlaceObject3 carries only the filter list; blend is absent.

FIX DIRECTION: in frames.ts, reorder the shape initial-placement else-if so a non-normal blendMode takes precedence (or is combined): when the shape has a non-normal blendMode, emit `encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(charId, depth, x, y, blendMode, displayObj.filters, objTransform, ..., cxform, ...)` passing the filter list as the filters arg (mirroring the instance path lines ~921-934), so a single PlaceObject3 carries both. Keep the filter-only branch for the no-blend case. NOTE: also audit the symbol-internal/sprite emit and the posChanged/move shape branches for the same ordering (related open tasks exist for the legacy compile.ts/sprite.ts posChanged paths, but this one is the frames.ts INITIAL-placement shape branch and is distinct).

ACCEPTANCE: unit test — compile a shape with a filter + blendMode='multiply', swf-dump (or parse PlaceObject3 flags2) and assert HasFilterList AND HasBlendMode both set with the correct blend value, matching the instance path. Per CLAUDE.md 'byte-presence is not runtime proof', also add/extend a Ruffle visual oracle if practical (see the filter-oracle hardening task).
